messages:
marta: Heads-up 1: NimbusCloud confirmed availability in Boreal-Edge (zone boreal-1). They can expose marketplace SKUs but we need quota entitlements, KMS connector certs, and marketplace listing approvals. Proposed soft-launch: June 2. Who picks up the entitlement flow?

devon: I can take entitlement. Need SKU IDs, initial reserved capacity, and a 30d traffic estimate to file quota.

mila (NimbusCloud): We can offer 10x NB-EDGE-XS (8x16GB vGPU) and 4x NB-EDGE-L (96GB). SKU IDs: NB-EDGE-XS, NB-EDGE-L. Expected warm-window QPS ~45k tokens/min. Quota form: https://nimbus.example/quotas/new (internal).

ash (product): For mapping, suggest 7 -> reserved, 3 -> burst. Also flagging that some customers will need VPC peering + private endpoints.

ryan: Infra checklist: subnet peering, route tables, firewall rules for the marketplace control plane, AMI bake for our image. Also note: boreal-1 has maintenance on Tue afternoon - avoid provisioning then. Recommend cross-zone fallback to boreal-2.

lee (legal): I'll start the DPA amendment for marketplace listing. Need Nimbus security questionnaire and KMS responsibilities. ETA 72h after questionnaire is received. Mila, can you push the questionnaire answers to the shared folder?

mila (NimbusCloud): Uploaded questionnaire to the quota form and shared the connector cert fingerprint: SHA256:9C3F...B7A2. Also confirmed they support external KMS via standard PKCS flow.

partners-bot: ticket PW-1515 created: "boreal-edge marketplace onboarding - NimbusCloud". Linked INF-4012 and LEG-889.

marta: Sync Thurs 11am PT items: 1) entitlement + quota timeline, 2) KMS connector cert validation, 3) infra runbook owner + dry-run, 4) marketplace listing copy & legal approvals, 5) customer comms cadence.

devon: I'll submit the entitlement request by EOD Wed with the traffic numbers.

mila (NimbusCloud): I'll coordinate cert exchange and confirm KMS testing window (prefer Thu am).

ryan: assigning runbook to @infra-oncall for bake + peering dry-run. Can you schedule Tue 08:30 PT?

infra-oncall: Got it. I'll run the dry-run Tue 08:30 PT and post logs in INF-4012.

lee (legal): once I get the questionnaire I'll fast-track the addendum. If we need additional clauses for marketplace liability, I'll flag them in LEG-889.

ash: drafting internal mapping doc and autoscale policy; will add to INF-4012 and share preread.

marta: pls ensure launch comms are gated on LEG-889 signoff and infra dry-run success. Add preread to: https://redwood.share/boreal-edge/onboard (internal). :rocket:

mila (NimbusCloud): excited to partner on this. I'll join Thurs sync.

devon: ack.
